timestamp_semantics: Monotonic logical append time after the Campaign280 final validated state; not a market-data or host-wall-clock measurement.
objective: Freeze a finite priority-ordered catalog of economically independent issuer external-state mechanisms before any Campaign281 targeted prior-definition or source-frontier search.

catalog_selection_rule.selection_method: After this file is immutable, inspect complete local terminal-definition and source-frontier evidence in catalog priority order. Select the first route that is economically independent, has a lawful and auditable 2019-2023 point-in-time issuer identity, availability, revision and complete-market denominator contract, and is not a same-mechanism source, entity-role, jurisdiction, formula, field, window or cohort rescue. Close every sibling and parameter variant. If no route survives, terminalize Campaign281 before formula, direction, provider, fields, source rows, factor values, comparison values, prices or returns.

concept_catalog.economic_state: Issuer project access and execution continuity reflected in public land acquisition, compulsory expropriation, compensation, resettlement, livelihood-restoration, objection, suspension and completion lifecycle records.

Issuer trade-facilitation and border-compliance standing reflected in public authorized-economic-operator application, certification, mutual recognition, inspection, suspension, revocation and reinstatement lifecycle records.

Issuer emergency healthcare capacity reflected in public facility designation, requisition, mobilization, surge-capacity activation, inspection, suspension, demobilization and restoration lifecycle records.
Issuer maritime response workload and execution reflected in public salvage, emergency towage, wreck-removal, pollution-control award, mobilization, completion, dispute and release lifecycle records.
Issuer access to public-sector demand reflected in public bidder qualification, exclusion, debarment, bid protest, administrative review, suspension, reinstatement and expiry lifecycle records.

Issuer site continuity and remediation burden reflected in public subsidence, sinkhole, landslide or ground-instability monitoring, warning, evacuation, closure, stabilization and clearance lifecycle records.

Issuer network or equipment continuity reflected in public harmful-interference complaint, frequency coordination, technical investigation, remediation order, suspension, clearance and closure lifecycle records.
